purpose: Frozen input schema of the ML2DAC CVI classifiers. Any Stage-4 ML2DAC adapter MUST build exactly this vector, in exactly this order.

authoritative_extractor.note: unified_mkr/metafeatures.py::extract_ml2dac is a FALLBACK path that calls the vendored ML2DAC MetaFeatureExtractor; it did NOT produce the master parquet. The master parquet was produced by pymfe_worker.py.

label_free.static: X-only. _build_decision_X drops the columns ('cluster_id','label','labels','y_true') before building the decision-space matrix; MFE.fit is called with X only (no y). None of the 52 columns is a pymfe label-dependent descriptor (no class_ent, mut_inf, joint_ent, ns_ratio, eq_num_attr, can_cor, gravity, nr_class, freq_class, class_conc).
label_free.behavioural: the real extraction path was executed with MFE.fit wrapped to raise on any target argument, and with the ground-truth label column first randomly permuted and then deleted entirely; all 52 features were bitwise unchanged in every case.

downstream_nan_policy: pymfe NaN -> 0.0 at extraction (numpy.nan_to_num in pymfe_worker._extract), then the frozen SimpleImputer.transform before the classifier. The adapter must reproduce BOTH steps in this order.

classifier_input_contract.output: raw class = metric_id; raw_result.selected_cvi is its CVI_ABBREV projection
